$comment: Defaults for the parallel-lanes skill. The repository overrides any key in .claude/parallel-lanes.json; absent keys fall back to these.

rules: Never restart or purge the shared local stack.
Stop only processes you started, by PID; never a broad pkill.
A 200 is not proof the server is yours: check the listener's working directory before trusting a port.
Fixtures are additive and prefixed with the lane id; never change or delete a seeded row another lane may use.
Integration tests run isolated; only E2E and manual runs touch the shared stack, under the e2e lock.
Never edit a migration already applied to the shared stack; fix forward with a new file.

delegated_to_coordinator: Assign lanes to workers and order the queue.
Grant and release the e2e and servers locks.
Answer reversible technical questions from the issue, spec, decisions files or code.
File follow-up issues reported by a lane.
